Rental days are counted in 24-hour blocks from the pick-up time, so returning later in the day than you picked up can add a day to the price.

dropoff_location.description:
**Where to return the car: a three-letter airport code** (e.g. `SEA`, `LAX`, `CDG`) **or a numeric `region_id`** from `/locations?type=cars` (a city or neighbourhood, e.g. `6139057` for Detroit).

Omit it to return the car where you picked it up. A different location makes the rental one-way (`rental.route_type: one_way`); one-way fees, when the supplier charges one, are shown by `/cars/details`.

sort.description:
**Order of the offers  -  and which 25 you get.** Optional; defaults to `recommended`.

- `recommended`  -  the storefront's own ranking (default)
- `price_low_to_high`  -  cheapest total first
- `distance`  -  nearest supplier branch first (city searches; same as `recommended` at an airport)

A search returns at most 25 offers and the sort decides which: `price_low_to_high` returns the 25 cheapest, which mostly differ from the recommended 25. Run several sorts, or narrow with filters, to see more of `total_cars`.

car_types.description:
**Keep only these car types, comma-separated** (e.g. `suv`, `compact,midsize`). Optional. Several values are combined with OR.

Accepted values: `mini`, `economy`, `compact`, `midsize`, `standard`, `fullsize`, `premium`, `luxury`, `convertible`, `minivan`, `suv`, `van`, `pickup`, `sports_car`, `other`. The types on offer for your search, with their cheapest price, are listed in `available_filters.car_types`.

suppliers.description:
**Keep only these rental companies, comma-separated, by the `value` listed in `available_filters.suppliers`** (e.g. `hertz`, `avis,budget`). Optional. Several values are combined with OR.

The suppliers differ per location and market  -  read them from a search at the same location on the same `market`: some storefronts list names (`hertz`, `alamo rent a car` on `us`), others two-letter supplier codes (`ZE`, `AL` for LHR on `uk`/`de`/`fr`/`au`; each offer's `supplier.code`). A value the search does not list returns a 400 that lists the ones it does.

capacity.description:
**Keep only cars of this seating capacity.** Optional.

- `two_to_five`  -  2 to 5 passengers
- `six_or_more`  -  6 or more passengers (minivans, 3-row SUVs, vans)

fuel_types.description:
**Keep only electric and/or hybrid cars, comma-separated.** Optional. Several values are combined with OR.

- `electric`  -  battery electric
- `hybrid`  -  hybrid

Each offer's fuel is also decoded in `vehicle.sipp.fuel`.

free_cancellation.description:
**Keep only offers that can be cancelled free of charge.** Optional; send `true` to apply.

`false` or omitted applies no cancellation filter. The cancellation terms of an offer are spelled out by `/cars/details` (`cancellation`, `policies`).

payment.description:
**Keep only offers paid this way.** Optional; both when omitted.

- `pay_now`  -  prepaid when booking (often cheaper; `price.prepaid: true`)
- `pay_later`  -  paid at the counter (`price.prepaid: false`)

pickup_options.description:
**Keep only offers with these faster pick-up options, comma-separated.** Optional. Several values are combined with OR.

- `skip_the_counter`  -  go straight to the car
- `online_checkin`  -  check in online before arriving

specifications.description:
**Keep only cars with these specifications, comma-separated.** Optional. Several values are combined with OR (`manual,all_wheel_drive` keeps manual cars and all-wheel-drive cars)  -  the platform offers no AND.

- `automatic`  -  automatic transmission (matters mostly outside North America)
- `manual`  -  manual transmission (offered where the fleet has manual cars, e.g. Europe)
- `unlimited_mileage`  -  no mileage cap
- `limited_mileage`  -  capped mileage offers only
- `all_wheel_drive`  -  all-wheel drive or 4x4

total_price_range.description:
**Keep only offers whose total falls in one price band**, as listed in `available_filters.total_price_ranges` (e.g. `100-200`, `500+`). Optional.

Bands are in the search's `currency` (US dollars on most markets  -  even where the band label shows the storefront's own symbol, e.g. "£100 to £200" on `uk`) and differ between locations  -  copy one from a search at the same location and market; a band the search does not list returns a 400 that lists the ones it does. On `jp`, `in` and `kr` the platform lists a single band, `4000+` in yen / rupees / won, which every offer satisfies.

airport_pickup.description:
**At an airport, keep only counters reached this way.** Optional; both when omitted.

- `at_terminal`  -  rental counter and car in the terminal
- `free_shuttle`  -  free shuttle to the counter and car

Each offer's `pickup.label` says which. Only the kinds the airport has are listed in `available_filters.airport_pickup`  -  asking for one it does not have answers an empty result; a search that offers neither (a city search) answers 400.

location_type.description:
**On a city search, keep only airport branches or only city branches.** Optional.

- `airport`  -  branches at the city's airports
- `non_airport`  -  branches in town

Offered on city searches whose branches include both kinds  -  see `available_filters.location_type`. A search that does not offer it (an airport search, or a city whose branches are all of one kind) answers 400 rather than silently ignoring it. Each offer's `pickup.type` is `airport` or `off_airport`.

search_radius.description:
**On a city search, how far from the city to include rental branches, in miles.** Optional; the platform's default is `10`.

- Offered on city and neighbourhood `region_id` searches only, with the values that search lists in `available_filters.search_radius` (some or all of `1`, `2`, `5`, `10`, `25`).
- A smaller radius keeps only nearby branches; a larger one adds branches further out. Each offer's `pickup.details` carries its distance from the searched place.
- A value the search does not list, or any value on an airport search, returns a 400.

deals_only.description:
**Keep only offers marked as a great deal.** Optional; send `true` to apply.

Deal offers carry a badge such as "Great Deal" or a discount in `badges`.

market.description:
**Which Expedia storefront to read from  -  decides the currency of every price and the language of labels and place names.** Optional; defaults to `us`.

Each storefront prices in its own currency and writes its labels (rating words, price notes, neighbourhood names) in its own language. Hotel names stay as the hotel wrote them. Ids (`region_id`, `hotel_id`) are the same on every storefront, so a search can be repeated on another market unchanged.

description: Search flight + hotel packages priced per traveller, with the saving against booking separately.

parameters.name: origin
parameters.description:
**Three-letter IATA code of the airport (or metro area) you fly from** (e.g. `SEA`, `JFK`, `LHR`, `NYC`). Required.

The package includes a round-trip economy flight from here. Unknown codes return a 404; find codes with `/locations?type=flights`.

schema.description:
**Three-letter IATA code of the airport (or metro area) you fly from** (e.g. `SEA`, `JFK`, `LHR`, `NYC`). Required.

The package includes a round-trip economy flight from here. Unknown codes return a 404; find codes with `/locations?type=flights`.

parameters.name: destination
parameters.description:
**Three-letter IATA code of the airport you fly to** (e.g. `LAS`, `CUN`, `BCN`). Required.

Hotels are searched in the wider area served by this airport (e.g. `LAS` → Las Vegas and vicinity) unless `region_id` narrows it. Unknown codes return a 404.

schema.description:
**Three-letter IATA code of the airport you fly to** (e.g. `LAS`, `CUN`, `BCN`). Required.

Hotels are searched in the wider area served by this airport (e.g. `LAS` → Las Vegas and vicinity) unless `region_id` narrows it. Unknown codes return a 404.

parameters.name: departure_date
parameters.description:
**Outbound flight date and hotel check-in, `YYYY-MM-DD`.** Required.

Must be today or later; the whole trip must end within 330 days.

schema.description:
**Outbound flight date and hotel check-in, `YYYY-MM-DD`.** Required.

Must be today or later; the whole trip must end within 330 days.

parameters.name: return_date
parameters.description:
**Return flight date and hotel check-out, `YYYY-MM-DD`.** Required.

At least one day after `departure_date`  -  a package includes at least one hotel night.

schema.description:
**Return flight date and hotel check-out, `YYYY-MM-DD`.** Required.

At least one day after `departure_date`  -  a package includes at least one hotel night.

parameters.name: region_id
parameters.description:
**Search hotels in this area instead of the destination airport's wider region**, by a `region_id` from `/locations` (a city or neighbourhood, e.g. `178276` for Las Vegas). Optional.

By default the hotel area is the "(and vicinity)" region around `destination`  -  echoed back as `trip.hotel_region_id`. An area more than 400 km from the `destination` airport is refused with a 400 (its hotels would not be at the flight's destination).

schema.description:
**Search hotels in this area instead of the destination airport's wider region**, by a `region_id` from `/locations` (a city or neighbourhood, e.g. `178276` for Las Vegas). Optional.

By default the hotel area is the "(and vicinity)" region around `destination`  -  echoed back as `trip.hotel_region_id`. An area more than 400 km from the `destination` airport is refused with a 400 (its hotels would not be at the flight's destination).

parameters.name: adults
parameters.description:
**Number of adults travelling.** Optional; defaults to `2`.

Every adult gets a flight seat and a place in the rooms (spread over `rooms`). At most 9 travellers including children. Package prices are per traveller.

schema.description:
**Number of adults travelling.** Optional; defaults to `2`.

Every adult gets a flight seat and a place in the rooms (spread over `rooms`). At most 9 travellers including children. Package prices are per traveller.

parameters.name: children_ages
parameters.description:
**Ages of the children travelling, comma-separated, each 0 - 17** (e.g. `4,9`). Optional.

Children are placed in the rooms in turn and fly as child travellers; they count towards the package total and the traveller limit. Children under 2 (ages `0` and `1`) fly as infants  -  see `infant_seating`.

schema.description:
**Ages of the children travelling, comma-separated, each 0 - 17** (e.g. `4,9`). Optional.

Children are placed in the rooms in turn and fly as child travellers; they count towards the package total and the traveller limit. Children under 2 (ages `0` and `1`) fly as infants  -  see `infant_seating`.

parameters.name: infant_seating
parameters.description:
**How children under 2 fly: `lap` (on an adult's lap) or `seat` (in their own seat).** Optional; defaults to `lap`. Only matters when `children_ages` includes a `0` or `1`.

A lap infant is cheaper than a seated one, and each lap infant needs its own adult  -  more infants than `adults` is a 400; use `seat` instead. The choice is echoed as `trip.travelers.infant_seating`.

schema.description:
**How children under 2 fly: `lap` (on an adult's lap) or `seat` (in their own seat).** Optional; defaults to `lap`. Only matters when `children_ages` includes a `0` or `1`.

A lap infant is cheaper than a seated one, and each lap infant needs its own adult  -  more infants than `adults` is a 400; use `seat` instead. The choice is echoed as `trip.travelers.infant_seating`.

parameters.name: rooms
parameters.description:
**Number of hotel rooms** (1 - 8). Optional; defaults to `1`.

`adults` must be at least `rooms`  -  every room needs an adult.

origin.description:
**Three-letter IATA code of the airport (or metro area) you fly from** (e.g. `SEA`, `JFK`, `LHR`, `NYC`). Required.

The package includes a round-trip economy flight from here. Unknown codes return a 404; find codes with `/locations?type=flights`.

destination.description:
**Three-letter IATA code of the airport you fly to** (e.g. `LAS`, `CUN`, `BCN`). Required.

Hotels are searched in the wider area served by this airport (e.g. `LAS` → Las Vegas and vicinity) unless `region_id` narrows it. Unknown codes return a 404.

departure_date.description:
**Outbound flight date and hotel check-in, `YYYY-MM-DD`.** Required.

Must be today or later; the whole trip must end within 330 days.

return_date.description:
**Return flight date and hotel check-out, `YYYY-MM-DD`.** Required.

At least one day after `departure_date`  -  a package includes at least one hotel night.

region_id.description:
**Search hotels in this area instead of the destination airport's wider region**, by a `region_id` from `/locations` (a city or neighbourhood, e.g. `178276` for Las Vegas). Optional.

By default the hotel area is the "(and vicinity)" region around `destination`  -  echoed back as `trip.hotel_region_id`. An area more than 400 km from the `destination` airport is refused with a 400 (its hotels would not be at the flight's destination).

adults.description:
**Number of adults travelling.** Optional; defaults to `2`.

Every adult gets a flight seat and a place in the rooms (spread over `rooms`). At most 9 travellers including children. Package prices are per traveller.

children_ages.description:
**Ages of the children travelling, comma-separated, each 0 - 17** (e.g. `4,9`). Optional.

Children are placed in the rooms in turn and fly as child travellers; they count towards the package total and the traveller limit. Children under 2 (ages `0` and `1`) fly as infants  -  see `infant_seating`.

infant_seating.description:
**How children under 2 fly: `lap` (on an adult's lap) or `seat` (in their own seat).** Optional; defaults to `lap`. Only matters when `children_ages` includes a `0` or `1`.

A lap infant is cheaper than a seated one, and each lap infant needs its own adult  -  more infants than `adults` is a 400; use `seat` instead. The choice is echoed as `trip.travelers.infant_seating`.

rooms.description:
**Number of hotel rooms** (1 - 8). Optional; defaults to `1`.

`adults` must be at least `rooms`  -  every room needs an adult.

sort.description:
**Order of the hotels.** Optional; defaults to `recommended`.

- `recommended`  -  the storefront's own ranking (default)
- `price_low_to_high`  -  cheapest package first
- `price_high_to_low`  -  most expensive package first
- `guest_rating`  -  highest hotel guest score first
- `star_rating`  -  highest hotel star class first

star_rating.description:
**Keep only hotels of these star classes, 1 - 5, comma-separated** (e.g. `4` or `4,5`). Optional; every class when omitted.

Each class includes its half step (`3` keeps 3 and 3.5-star hotels); several classes are combined with OR, so `4,5` keeps 4, 4.5 and 5-star hotels. Each hotel's class is in its `star_rating`.

guest_rating_min.description:
**Keep only hotels whose guest score (out of 10) is at least this:** `9`, `8` or `7`. Optional.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description:
**Order of the results.** Optional; defaults to `recommended`.

- `recommended`  -  the storefront's own ranking (best sellers and top rated first)
- `price_low_to_high`  -  cheapest first
- `price_high_to_low`  -  most expensive first (private tours, multi-day trips, VIP packages)
- `deals`  -  discounted activities first (roughly the biggest discount first, each with a `price.strikethrough`), then the rest without a discount; `features=deals` keeps only the discounted ones

The price orders follow the price the activity can be booked at for your dates, which is not always the card's headline `price.lead_amount` (a card can show a higher lead than its bookable tickets), so some rows look out of `lead_amount` order. `/activities/offers` has the exact bookable prices.

Every sort orders the same full list (`total_activities`); page through it with `page`.

- `50_to_75`  -  $50 to $75
- `75_to_100`  -  $75 to $100
- `over_100`  -  Greater than $100

Several ranges apply as one span from the lowest to the highest, so ranges with a gap between them (`under_25,over_100`) are rejected with a 400 rather than silently filled in. An activity matches on its bookable ticket prices for the dates, so now and then a row's headline `lead_amount` falls outside the range; `/activities/offers` has the exact prices.

region_id.description:
**Where to look for activities, as a `region_id` from `/locations`**  -  a city, wider "(and vicinity)" region, neighbourhood or landmark (e.g. `178293` New York and vicinity, `179898` Paris and vicinity, `179900` Tokyo). Send this, `destination`, or `latitude` + `longitude`.

The most reliable way to name a destination; `/locations?type=activities` suggests the regions activities are organised by. A landmark id searches the city around it. An id that matches no destination returns a 404.

destination.description:
**Where to look for activities, as free text** (e.g. `Las Vegas`, `Paris, France`, `Cancun`). Used only when `region_id` is not sent.

The text is matched to the closest known destination and echoed as `destination.resolved_region_id` / `resolved_full_name`  -  check it, because a vague name can match somewhere unexpected. Text that matches nothing returns a 404. Plain text only (no angle brackets, braces or back-ticks).

latitude.description:
**Latitude of a point, in decimal degrees (-90 to 90)** (e.g. `40.758`). Optional; send together with `longitude`, instead of `region_id` / `destination`.

- Searches the smallest destination that contains the point, echoed as `destination.resolved_region_id` / `resolved_full_name`.
- Results follow the chosen `sort`, not distance; each activity carries `distance_km` from the point, which also shows the few listed activities that lie far from their destination.
- A point with no destination around it returns a 404.

longitude.description:
**Longitude of a point, in decimal degrees (-180 to 180)** (e.g. `-73.9855`). Optional; send together with `latitude`.

See `latitude`: the point selects the destination that contains it, and every activity carries `distance_km` from the point.

start_date.description:
**First day the traveller can do activities, as `YYYY-MM-DD`** (e.g. `2027-06-15`). Send it together with `end_date`, or omit both.

Must be today or later. When both dates are omitted the range is today to 14 days out, and the range used is echoed back. Prices, availability and which activities are listed depend on these dates.

end_date.description:
**Last day the traveller can do activities, as `YYYY-MM-DD`** (e.g. `2027-06-18`)  -  may equal `start_date` for a single day.

At most 14 days after `start_date`, and no more than 320 days from today; longer or later ranges are rejected with a 400 that says why.

sort.description:
**Order of the results.** Optional; defaults to `recommended`.

- `recommended`  -  the storefront's own ranking (best sellers and top rated first)
- `price_low_to_high`  -  cheapest first
- `price_high_to_low`  -  most expensive first (private tours, multi-day trips, VIP packages)
- `deals`  -  discounted activities first (roughly the biggest discount first, each with a `price.strikethrough`), then the rest without a discount; `features=deals` keeps only the discounted ones

The price orders follow the price the activity can be booked at for your dates, which is not always the card's headline `price.lead_amount` (a card can show a higher lead than its bookable tickets), so some rows look out of `lead_amount` order. `/activities/offers` has the exact bookable prices.

Every sort orders the same full list (`total_activities`); page through it with `page`.

category.description:
**Only activities in these categories, comma-separated; categories combine as OR** (e.g. `food_drink,nightlife` lists activities in either).

- `tours_sightseeing`  -  Tours & sightseeing
- `tickets_passes`  -  Tickets & passes
- `excursions_day_tours`  -  Excursions & day tours
- `view_points`  -  View points
- `audio_tours`  -  Audio based tours
- `shore_excursions`  -  Shore excursions
- `cruises_water_tours`  -  Cruises, sailing & water tours
- `outdoor_adventure`  -  Outdoor & adventure
- `sports`  -  Sports
- `food_drink`  -  Food & drink
- `nightlife`  -  Nightlife & party experiences
- `history_culture`  -  History & culture
- `specialty_niche`  -  Specialty & niche
- `shows_concerts_sports`  -  Shows, concerts & sports
- `airport_services`  -  Airport services (lounges, luggage, transfers)
- `essentials`  -  Essentials (e.g. SIM cards, luggage storage)
- `bundled`  -  Bundles
- `workshops_classes`  -  Workshops & classes
- `wellness_relaxation`  -  Wellness & relaxation

Each destination offers a subset, listed with the storefront's own labels under `filter_options.categories`; a category the destination does not offer is reported in `unavailable_filters` (and, when none of the requested categories is offered, the list is empty).

features.description:
**Only activities with ALL of these, comma-separated** (each one narrows the list further, and combines as AND with every other filter).

- `free_cancellation`  -  Free cancellation
- `deals`  -  Deals (discounted)
- `family_friendly`  -  Family friendly
- `local_expert_picks`  -  Local expert picks
- `new_on_expedia`  -  New on Expedia
- `hotel_pickup`  -  Pickup from selected hotels

The ones a destination offers are listed under `filter_options.features`; one it does not offer is reported in `unavailable_filters` and empties the list.

keyword.description:
**Only activities matching this text** (e.g. `food tour`). Optional; plain text, up to 100 characters.

- Matched by relevance on each activity's full content: the best matches come first and show the word in their `name` or `description`; further down the list the matches are looser and may not name it.
- Text that matches nothing returns an empty list.

price_range.description:
**Only activities whose price per person is in this range  -  one value, or several ADJACENT ranges comma-separated** (e.g. `25_to_50,50_to_75` = $25 - 75). US market (`market=us`, US dollars) only  -  other markets answer 400.

- `under_25`  -  Less than $25
- `25_to_50`  -  $25 to $50
- `50_to_75`  -  $50 to $75
- `75_to_100`  -  $75 to $100
- `over_100`  -  Greater than $100

Several ranges apply as one span from the lowest to the highest, so ranges with a gap between them (`under_25,over_100`) are rejected with a 400 rather than silently filled in. An activity matches on its bookable ticket prices for the dates, so now and then a row's headline `lead_amount` falls outside the range; `/activities/offers` has the exact prices.

min_rating.description:
**Only activities rated at least this score out of 10 by travellers.** One value. Optional.

- `7`  -  Good 7+
- `8`  -  Very good 8+
- `9`  -  Wonderful 9+

Applied to the same rating the cards show (`rating.score`, a partner's rating for partner-sold activities). Activities without any rating are excluded when this is set.

duration.description:
**Only activities of these lengths, comma-separated (lengths combine as OR).**

- `under_1_hour`  -  Less than 1 hour
- `1_to_4_hours`  -  1 to 4 hours
- `4_hours_to_1_day`  -  4 hours to 1 day
- `over_1_day`  -  More than 1 day

Measured on the activity itself (a 30-day city pass counts as more than 1 day).

start_time.description:
**Only activities that can start in these parts of the day, comma-separated (combine as OR).**

- `morning`  -  6:00am - 12:00pm (morning)
- `afternoon`  -  12:00pm - 5:00pm (afternoon)
- `evening`  -  5:00pm - 12:00am (evening)
- `any_time`  -  Any time (open-dated tickets and passes)

An activity with several start times matches every part of the day it runs in; exact times per date come from `/activities/offers`.

landmark_ids.description:
**Only activities that visit or include these landmarks, comma-separated (combine as OR), up to 10.**

Landmark ids are destination-specific: take them from `filter_options.landmarks` of a search for the same destination (e.g. `502066` Statue of Liberty, `502075` Empire State Building in New York). A pass or cruise that includes the landmark matches too, so this is about content, not distance. An id that is not a landmark of the destination is reported in `unavailable_filters`.

parameters.name: sort

market.description:
**Which Expedia storefront to read from  -  decides the currency of every price and the language of labels and place names.** Optional; defaults to `us`.

Each storefront prices in its own currency and writes its labels (rating words, price notes, neighbourhood names) in its own language. Hotel names stay as the hotel wrote them. Ids (`region_id`, `hotel_id`) are the same on every storefront, so a search can be repeated on another market unchanged.

Some storefronts also offer a second language: `ca_fr` (French), `hk_en`, `tw_en`, `jp_en`, `th_en`, `id_en` (English) and `hk_cn` (Simplified Chinese) are the `ca`, `hk`, `tw`, `jp`, `th` and `id` storefronts  -  same prices, currency and results  -  with their text in that language.
